symptom: GitHub merge API reported Required status check "test" is expected while the exact PR head had a successful Required test job and successful test status from the GitHub Actions app.
rootCause: Protected-branch status recognition was coupled to a synthetic/up-to-date merge-ref context on which GitHub exposed no corresponding check-runs, not to a substantive test failure.
failedApproach: Rerunning substantive test suites or disabling the required test gate would not repair the status/ref association and creates unnecessary queue load or weaker protection.
fix: Keep test required, distinguish exact-head status from synthetic merge-ref status, and only relax the up-to-date/synthetic-ref requirement when direct GitHub evidence proves that mismatch.
prevention: Release diagnostics classify failed, queued, success, success_but_not_recognized, expected_on_synthetic_ref and provider_mismatch before deciding whether any test rerun is justified.
regressionContract: When exact head test/status is success from app_id 15368, synthetic merge check-runs are empty and merge API says test is expected, classification must be expected_on_synthetic_ref with rerunTests=false and disableRequiredCheck=false.
